grammar.title: A soft apology with 不好意思
grammar.explanation: 不好意思 (bù hǎoyìsi) is a common phrase meaning "sorry, excuse me" or "to feel embarrassed" softer than 对不起, often used for small inconveniences.

grammar.title: Feeling sad with 难过
grammar.explanation: 难过 (nánguò) means "to feel sad, upset" literally "hard to get through". It's an adjective describing an emotional state.

sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào zhè jiàn shì, wǒ hěn nánguò.
sentences.en: Hearing about this made me sad.

sentences.pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ lái wǎn le.

sentences.zh: 不好意思，请问洗手间在哪儿？
sentences.pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, qǐngwèn xǐshǒujiān zài nǎr?
Tā bù hǎoyìsi de xiào le.
Zhème guì, wǒ bù hǎoyìsi mǎi.
sentences.en: It's so expensive, I feel embarrassed buying it.

sentences.pinyin: Zhège bāo yòu piányi yòu hǎo.
sentences.en: This bag is both cheap and good.

sentences.pinyin: Zhège cài yòu piányi yòu hǎochī.
sentences.en: This dish is both cheap and delicious.
